gloss: great blessing; very lucky; best fortune

definitions.gloss: great blessing; excellent fortune; best luck
definitions.explanation: The highest rank of fortune on an omikuji (fortune slip) drawn at a shrine or temple. By extension, used to describe something extremely lucky or auspicious.

examples.japanese: おみくじ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{大吉|だいきち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧！
examples.english: I drew the best fortune on my omikuji!

examples.japanese: {初詣|はつもうで}で{大吉|だいきち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}いて→引く：01978_hiku⟧、{幸先|さいさき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: I drew the best fortune at the New Year shrine visit — a good omen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{三年|さんねん}→三年：10984_sannen⟧⟦{連続|れんぞく}→連続：03783_renzoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{大吉|だいきち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}いた→引く：01978_hiku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧そうだ。
examples.english: I've drawn the best fortune three years in a row, so this year looks like it will be a good one too.

notes:
The highest-ranked fortune on an おみくじ (fortune slip) drawn at shrines and temples. {大|だい} means 'great' and ⟦{吉|きち}→吉：19344_kichi⟧ means 'good fortune.'

OMIKUJI FORTUNE RANKINGS (from best to worst):
- {大吉|だいきち} — great blessing
- ⟦{吉|きち}→吉：19344_kichi⟧ — blessing
- ⟦{中吉|ちゅうきち}→中吉：29072_chuukichi⟧ — moderate blessing
- ⟦{小吉|しょうきち}→小吉：29073_shoukichi⟧ — small blessing
- ⟦{末吉|すえきち}→末吉：29074_suekichi⟧ — near-blessing
- ⟦{凶|きょう}→凶：19345_kyou⟧ — bad luck
- ⟦{大凶|だいきょう}→大凶：25063_daikyou⟧ — terrible luck

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大吉|だいきち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧ — to draw the best fortune
- {大吉|だいきち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ — to get the best fortune
- おみくじ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{大吉|だいきち} — best fortune on an omikuji

CULTURAL NOTE:
Drawing おみくじ is a popular custom at ⟦{初詣|はつもうで}→初詣：05804_hatsumoude⟧ (first shrine visit of the year). Getting {大吉|だいきち} is considered very auspicious. Some people tie bad fortune slips to a tree at the shrine to leave the bad luck behind, while keeping {大吉|だいきち} slips.
